unit.title: Data Display and Interpretation
unit.blurb: Reading and drawing pictograms and bar charts with scales, dot plots, and using the mode to describe data.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Represent and interpret data in pictograms and bar charts with scales in 2s, 5s and 10s.

O2.t: Represent data in dot plots and use the mode to describe and compare data.

p: In a **pictogram**, the **key** tells you what one picture stands for: if ● = 5, then ●●● = 15 and half a picture is 1 when ● = 2.
In a **bar chart**, the **scale** may go up in 2s, 5s or 10s. A bar halfway between 20 and 30 shows 25.
Count how much each grid line is worth before reading a bar.

p: A **dot plot** shows each piece of data as a dot above a number line.
The **mode** is the value that appears most often – the tallest column of dots.
The mode is the value (1 pet), not how many dots there are (5).
